title: Sampled Values Ethernet frame with 0x60 SAV APDU
purpose: Provide a complete Ethernet Sampled Values frame using EtherType 0x88ba and the documented outer SAV APDU tag 0x60 rather than opaque filler alone.
expected_behavior: A link-layer dissector should classify EtherType 0x88ba as Sampled Values and then enter SAV APDU parsing at outer tag 0x60.
constraints_preserved: A complete Ethernet frame is emitted.
Payload begins with documented SAV PDU outer tag 0x60.
Inner TLVs are BER-consistent and small.
issue_safety_notes: This is a benign structured SAV seed and does not copy any known crash input.
